findings.mechanism: 07-connection-pools — the configured pool_size (20) plus max_overflow (10) yields 30 possible connections per process. With 4 uvicorn workers this totals 120 connections, exceeding PostgreSQL's default max_connections (100) and reserved superuser slots, leading to connection errors and worker saturation.
findings.remediation: Reduce pool_size and max_overflow so that (pool_size+max_overflow) ≤ floor((max_connections‑reserved)/workers). For default max_connections=100 and reserved=5, each of the 4 workers may use ≤23 connections. Set pool_size=10 and max_overflow=5 in create_async_engine.
findings.arithmetic: max_connections=100, reserved=5 → usable=95. workers=4 → per‑worker limit=95/4≈23.75. Configured per‑worker connections=20+10=30 >23 → risk of exceeding 100 total connections. At full load (30 concurrent requests per worker) active_connections can reach 120 ≥100.
